description: The statistics service of Wallis and Futuna (STSEE) publishes its main census housing tables as spreadsheets for the 2023, 2018 and 2013 censuses. The 2023 workbook, compiled with INSEE and updated in January 2024, has thirteen housing tables. They count dwellings by category and main residences by construction type, including traditional fale and modern houses, by tenure, rooms and year completed from before 1990. The lighting table splits households and population between the general grid, generators, solar panels and kerosene lamps; on Wallis 2,262 of 2,272 main residences use the grid. Other tables cover running water inside or outside the home, toilets and showers, appliances such as solar, gas and electric water heaters and air conditioners, internet, 4G and ADSL, and vehicles. Every table is by district and circonscription. Coverage is the whole territory of about 11,000 people. Format and access: free XLSX and ODS files, no registration. Licence: none found. Caveats: tables are small-area counts only, with no microdata; some totals are spreadsheet formulas; the round 1 visit read only the homepage. Simulation uses: grid, generator and solar shares and building types for cyclone exposure and island energy planning. Related records: the SPC Pacific Data Hub census household counts and electricity access record.
